items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Bud Scott and Johnny and that bunch... we were rehearsing

ctx.x: Bud Scott and Johnny and that bunch. This later, I don't know, I can't remember her name, but we were rehearsing and she was singing and so she stopped and she said, I can't sing that song on that temperature. She broke up the record and said, oh, the band fell out, laughed, you know, and she was looking me straight in the face and I couldn't laugh. she still doesn't know what to say. Bud Scott said, well, what temperature would you like?
